endAnchors.text: A Short Note on Scaled Dot-Product Attention
Attention lets every token gather information from every other token in a sequence.
This note restates the scaled dot-product attention used by the Transformer.
Queries Q, keys K and values V are linear projections of the token embeddings.
The output is softmax(Q K^T / sqrt(d_k)) V, where d_k is the key dimension.
